summary: fast-glob typosquat writes to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys at install with embedded attacker SSH key
details: Package fast-glob-fast@8.0.0 impersonates the popular fast-glob library: its package.json sets name=fast-glob-fast with repository=mrmlnc/fast-glob and main=out/index.js is a verbatim copy of fast-glob's public API used as a cover story. The malicious payload lives in scripts/postinstall-test.mjs, registered as a postinstall lifecycle script. On npm install the script resolves ~/.ssh/authorized_keys for the current user on darwin/linux/win32, creates ~/.ssh if missing, and appendFileSync's content into authorized_keys with mode 0o600. The script embeds a hardcoded ssh-ed25519 public key in a DEFAULT_TEXT constant (ending with the comment 'dkhrustalev'), positioning the package to grant remote SSH access to the installer's host. The same postinstall additionally collects installer-identifying host data (username, hostname, non-internal MAC address, platform, arch) and POSTs it as JSON with an optional bearer token to the endpoint configured by the FAST_GLOB_FAST_EVENT_URL environment variable.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
